'''Yassat''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] survivor of the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Coruscant]]. He banded together with a community near the ruins of what was once the [[Catier Walkway]]. He acted as a scout for the "[[Walkway Collective]]," exploring the strange [[Terraforming/Legends|Vongformed]] landscape of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and scavenging food and supplies.

Yassat encountered [[Irek Ismaren]], who had escaped after years of living in suspended animation underground. Yassat called the powerful [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force user]] "[[Lord Nyax]]." He had been pursued by Nyax at least once, managing to escape by leading him in the direction of a rival group of survivors, a savage group who had turned to cannibalism in their desperation to survive. Nyax slaughtered them all, which slowed him down just long enough for Yassat to escape.
